visual_language.target: expressive, human performance; graphic silhouettes; tactile painted textures; layered lighting; fluid, intentional motion
avoid: flat placeholder shapes as final art
design_principles: distinct posture and movement vocabulary for each character
costume wear and material reflect story and social position
faces remain nuanced and emotionally readable
all appearance details not explicitly sourced are proposals requiring author approval

characters.name: Kaylen Atlee
characters.source_role: Central viewpoint character; Grave Choir survivor
source_anchors: looks down while Juno treats his injury
characters.design_proposal: Lean, guarded silhouette with a slightly closed posture; movement economical and watchful. Costume should feel lived-in and practical for Vesper street life. Keep face, skin tone, hair, age-specific features and exact garments TBD pending source/reference confirmation.
characters.performance: micro-expressions, delayed eye contact, tension held in jaw and shoulders; avoid action-hero swagger

characters.name: Eamon Voss
source_anchors: enters the print shop in a dark coat
uses commands that can sound like invitations
characters.design_proposal: Controlled vertical silhouette; composed stillness; dark coat as the only presently source-grounded costume element. Facial and body details TBD.
characters.performance: minimal gestures; claims space through timing and eye-line rather than exaggerated menace

characters.name: Juno Saye
characters.source_role: Grave Choir member; offers practical care
source_anchors: care is offered without demanding eye contact
characters.design_proposal: Practical, mobile silhouette with clear access to medical pouch; exact appearance and clothing TBD.
characters.performance: precise hands, calm focus, kindness expressed through action rather than sentimentality
